bundle.longDescription: Orca Rust Desktop (Fase 4) is the full-Rust build of Orca whose window loads the upstream DESKTOP renderer locally and talks to the in-process Rust runtime through a window.api bridge — no server, no pairing for its own machine. It uses its own Orca RS profile, separate from the original Orca, so both can run at the same time.
bundle.shortDescription: Orca Rust Desktop - desktop renderer on the Rust runtime, no server
